faq.a: No. You can send files up to {limit} without signing in.

faq.q: How long does my link last?
faq.a: Links work for {days} days. After that the file is deleted and the link stops working.

faq.q: Can the recipient see my name?
faq.a: Only if you tell them. The download page shows nothing about you.

faq.q: What happens to my file once the link expires?
faq.a: It is removed from storage. We do not keep a copy.

feats.p: Every link works for {days} days, so nothing is left lying around.

ui.desc_privacy: What happens to your files and your details at {brand}.
ui.privacy_intro: A short account of what happens to your file and to the details of your transfer.

privacy.p: The file you upload and the time you uploaded it. We do not ask for your name, and we do not keep a list of the people who download it.
Until the link expires. After that the file is deleted from storage and cannot be recovered.
Anyone who has the link. We do not open or read your files, so share the link only with the people who should have the file.
We use only what the page needs in order to work. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
Ask the person who looks after {brand} for your organization to remove a file before its link expires.
